parameters.query:
SELECT
  b.id,
  c.phone              AS customer_phone,
  c.name               AS customer_name,
  b.event_date::text   AS event_date,
  b.event_time::text   AS event_time,
  b.delivery_address,
  b.city,
  b.deposit_paid,
  b.deposit_amount,
  COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT STRING_AGG(e.name, ', ' ORDER BY e.name)
      FROM batutynas.booking_equipment be
      JOIN batutynas.equipment e ON e.id = be.equipment_id
      WHERE be.booking_id = b.id
    ),
    'batutas'
  ) AS equipment_list
FROM batutynas.bookings b
JOIN batutynas.contacts c ON c.id = b.contact_id
WHERE b.event_date = CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day'
  AND b.status NOT IN ('Cancelled')
  AND b.reminder_sent = FALSE
ORDER BY b.event_time;
